tradition_assertions.notes: Reviewed work/title crosswalk: the Church's numbered list names Joel; TAU's index gives the Latinized form Ioel, and its book page identifies the Ethiopic Book of Joel. This is a title/work match only; Dillmann's historical witness, label anomalies, accuracy, and completeness are not thereby certified as the current Church text. British Library Add MS 16189's catalog lists the Twelve Prophets in this Ge'ez codex at folios 42v–64v and names a starting folio for each. This is manuscript-catalog evidence only; it does not verify a transcription, complete book boundaries, or identity with a particular current Church edition. Standard USFM title-candidate research readers are catalogued for Joel.
